title: Partnership with the Holy Spirit
speaker: Pastor John Anosike
transcript:
[0:00] Breaking news. This is an exclusive announcement from the office of the bond servant of Christ John. A powerful exclusive partnership online prayer going live on the new D Realms app. Join the bond servant of Christ for a life-transforming moment of prayer,

[0:16] miracles, and divine encounter. This is the first prayer meeting [music] for all the covenant partners for the first quarter of 2026. This will be an upper room experience. I am a giver, >> [singing] >> a [music] sower,

[0:32] a co-laborer [singing] of Christ. >> [music] >> I believe in this mandate >> [singing] >> of sonship >> [music] >> and immortality. Date, the 23rd of May, 2026. Time,

[0:49] [music] 6:00 p.m. South African time. This is not for everyone. Attendance is strictly for all the covenant partners. To participate, all covenant partners [music] must have a ROAR ID. If you don't have a ROAR ID, sign up on our website to get one. [music]

[1:04] tribe.erelms.tc.org. If you're not a covenant partner yet, but want to be part of this prayer meeting, kindly secure your place now. Scan the QR code and sign up to be part of this divine meeting. Don't miss it.

[1:20] Your moment is now. Exclusive partnership online prayer with the bond servant of Christ [music] John. You are next in line to testify. I am a covenant partner of the bond servant >> [singing]

[1:35] >> of Christ. I AM >> [music]

[1:38] >> A GIVER.
summary: The sermon frames a forthcoming online prayer as an intimate, covenant‑based partnership between believers and the Holy Spirit, stressing the roles of giving, co‑labor, and sonship. It positions the participants as active actors in a divine economy, inviting them to receive a direct encounter with God’s presence.

interpretation.summary: The sermon frames a forthcoming online prayer as an intimate, covenant‑based partnership between believers and the Holy Spirit, stressing the roles of giving, co‑labor, and sonship. It positions the participants as active actors in a divine economy, inviting them to receive a direct encounter with God’s presence.
key_points: The event is exclusive to ‘covenant partners’—a call for commitment and identity within God’s community.
Participants are urged to embrace the roles of giver, sower, and co‑laborer, underscoring a generous, collaborative spirit.
The call to sonship and immortality frames the experience as transformative, promising participation in God’s eternal plan.
biblical_themes: Partnership with the Holy Spirit as a collaborative work of salvation
Giving and generosity as expressions of covenant faith
Sonship and the identity of believers within God’s family
